messages:
elaine: quick question  small decision between inline tooltips on first visit vs a persistent left rail for the first-run checklist. leaning tooltip for low visual weight. thoughts?

rory: tooltips are lightweight but easy to miss. persistent rail nudges more reliably for completion.

sam: data point: persistent surfaces increase completion but also increase dismissals. if we go rail, make it dismissible and snoozeable.

oliver: accessibility: tooltips must be accessible on keyboard (focusable trigger + visible tooltip), but many tooltip implementations are broken. rail is easier for screen reader users if it's a real region with aria-labelledby.

marta: experiment idea: control = inline tooltips, variant = persistent rail. primary metric = onboarding completion; secondary = dismiss rate and support mentions. i'll add telemetry keys: onboarding.tooltip.view, onboarding.rail.view, onboarding.rail.snooze.

elaine: UX compromise: start with subtle tooltips for the first two steps, then surface a small persistent rail after 30s if user hasn't progressed. hybird approach?

rory: agree hybrid makes sense. engineering Q: is delaying the rail costly?

sam: cheap to implement: set a client-side timer and record impression only if rail actually shown. ensure we don't double-count impressions if user navigates.

oliver: if you auto-show the rail after timer, remember to manage focus: don't steal focus unexpectedly. when rail appears, it should be aria-hidden until user expands or explicitly focuses it.

marta: noted. telemetry rule: only fire onboarding.rail.view when user expands or interacts, not on auto-render.

elaine: microcopy suggestion: tooltip CTAs use "Try this"; rail CTA uses "Complete setup". sam, can you produce 2 microcopy variants for A/B?

sam: yup will add "Try this" vs "Give it a try" and "Complete setup" vs "Finish setup". will upload to figma Thu AM.

deploy-bot: reminder: onboarding design freeze Fri 5pm PT. link final comps to release ticket.

elaine: action items: sam - microcopy variants + figma frames; oliver - a11y checklist for tooltip and rail; marta - experiment matrix + telemetry; rory - mock timing behaviour in prototype. sync Fri 9am if needed.
